name: private-wealth-advisory-planning
description: Solve private wealth advisory structured-output tasks (Roth conversion / RMD tax, ILIT Crummey funding, GRAT vs CRAT comparison, and integrated estate-liquidity action plans) by querying a read-only advisory HTTP API, resolving conflicting source documents by priority, applying the derived business formulas, and emitting a single JSON object that conforms to the task's answer_template.json. Use this whenever a task asks for a structured planning output for a client CLT-#### in the private-wealth domain.

findings.excerpt: All endpoints are GET and return JSON. Use `curl -s --max-time 30`.
